'''The Giant Step''' was a [[Cantina/Legends|bar]] in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Takari]], on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Iyuta]]. Located on [[The Strip]], which was part of [[Vark Street]], it catered to bored [[Imperial Marines/Legends|Imperial Marines]]. The [[Chilla (impersonator)|imposter]] posing as the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance]] [[operative]] [[Chilla]] worked at The Giant Step.<ref name="Plant" />
